test_cases.description: Invalid semver string should raise a parse error (language-specific: ValueError in Python, Error in TS, ParseError in Rust)

driver_contract.assert_the_wire_code: `expected_error` is a wire code. The apcore-python driver asserted the class `VersionIncompatibleError` for one code and fell through to `pytest.raises(Exception)` for every other — the weakest possible assertion, satisfied by any error at all.
driver_contract.unknown_expectation_must_fail: An expectation the driver does not recognise MUST be a hard FAILURE, never a skipped branch. Both shapes were found here: `if error_code == "X": ...` with no else, and `else: raises(Exception)` which accepts anything. Both turn a wrong fixture value into a passing test, so the contract becomes the driver's literal and the fixture is decoration. The pattern that works is in this repo already — pipeline_failfast_config's driver panics with "teach the driver, do not skip it" and has stayed honest through four rounds of new cases.
